messages:
Marta (CSM): Morning — quick pulse on ClearWave onboarding before the call. Saw a sharp jump in error rate overnight. 24h summary: 5xx = 6.4% (baseline ~0.9%), timeouts = 2.1%, rate_limit = 1.8%. Top failing endpoints by count: 1) POST /v1/generate 2) POST /v1/embeddings 3) POST /v1/session/complete. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/clearwave/health :warning:
Tyler (Customer Success): yikes. any config/traffic changes on their side? ramping? :thinking_face:
Marta (CSM): They increased concurrent users yesterday and started sending longer contexts in the web client. I flagged it to them — will confirm exact time, but symptoms line up with a push at ~22:00 UTC.
Sara (SRE): I pulled worker logs around 22:10-22:30. Seeing lots of write failures and connection resets on the generate route — looks like socket exhaustion and occasional OOM retries. snippet: ```ERROR 2025-06-12T22:12:31Z service=runtime route=/v1/generate err="write tcp 10.4.2.1:443: write: broken pipe"``` Also a series of 504s from the gateway due to backend timeouts.
Jin (Solutions Eng): Confirmed via sample payloads — they started attaching full conversation history (~18k tokens) in the input. That explains higher KV cache miss rate and longer decoding windows. We saw latency tail climb which exposes transient 5xx.
DeployBot: Autoscaler: scaled dedicated-pool-clearwave 4 -> 6 GPUs at 2025-06-12T22:15:03Z due to sustained CPU>70%.
Lucas (Account Exec): Marta — is renewal at risk? Should we pause ramp until we stabilize?
Marta (CSM): Renewal conversation is next quarter but immediate churn risk minimal if we act fast. Proposed short-term mitigations below.
Tyler (Customer Success): Please list action items and owners so I can track with the customer.
Sara (SRE): Action 1 (SRE): Investigate root cause for 5xx write/broken-pipe + add connection pool/backpressure limits by EOD. I can start now, ETA 4h.
Jin (Solutions Eng): Action 2 (SE): Recommend client-side changes: 1) enable streaming responses for long contexts, 2) truncate/roll conversation history server-side, 3) batch embeddings calls where possible. Draft config snippet: ```# recommend: streaming + chunking
client.send({stream: true, max_history_tokens: 4096})``` I’ll share a short guide by tomorrow morning.
Marta (CSM): Action 3 (CSM): I’ll ask ClearWave to rollback their 22:00 deploy to previous client version for the next 24h and throttle concurrent sessions to 60% of current while we stabilize.
Tyler (Customer Success): Action 4 (Ops): Temporarily enable circuit-breaker on /v1/generate at gateway for requests > 15s to avoid cascading failures. Sara / Eng oncall ok to implement?
Sara (SRE): I’ll schedule a quick rule; can push a gateway policy in the next 60 mins.
Jin (Solutions Eng): Also suggest using the smaller embedding model for batch embedding of metadata. That should cut tokens and rate-limit pressure.
DeployBot: Incident note created: INC-20250612-1742 -> clearwave-high-5xx. Tags: onboarding, customer-traffic, autoscale.
Lucas (Account Exec): Good. I'll message their engineering PM to request an immediate partial rollback and offer an on-call SE for 1 hour.
Marta (CSM): Summary/next steps: - SRE (Sara) investigating OOM/socket failures, push connection limits + gateway circuit-breaker (ETA 1h) - SE (Jin) to propose client changes + guide (ETA 12h) - Marta to coordinate rollback & throttle with customer (in-flight) - Lucas to manage customer comms & offer hands-on support
Tyler (Customer Success): sgtm. Please drop any logs or dashboards into the thread.
Sara (SRE): Pasting quick query to monitor top endpoints by 5xx in last 6h (KQL): ```search status_code >= 500 | top route by count(1h) | where customer_id == 'clearwave'```
Marta (CSM): Thanks — attaching initial screenshots in the onboarding ticket. Will update this thread after rollback confirmation. :thumbsup:
Tyler (Customer Success): Thanks everyone. If we can stabilize by EOD we can keep the onboarding cadence. If not, we'll pause new signups.
Lucas (Account Exec): I'll wait for Marta's update and then escalate in the renewal thread if needed.
Marta (CSM): Update 23:05 UTC — ClearWave rolled back client, they're throttling sessions to 50%. Early indicators: 5xx dropped to 1.9% in the first 30m. Monitoring.
Sara (SRE): Noted. I'll keep the autoscaler and connection fixes running; will post deeper postmortem if we see regression.
Jin (Solutions Eng): Good signal. I'll assemble a short CONFIG + best-practices doc for them in the morning.
Marta (CSM): Closing the loop here for now. Will add final notes to the onboarding playbook once we confirm stable 24h baseline. :white_check_mark:
